guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Start with a Hand
Preparator and
furnace. Make a Cell,
then connect
Decomposer, Drive and
Synthesizer to turn
sand into glass.

The Cell stays in the
Drive. No Analyzer,
AE2 or RS is required.
guide.rematter.page.2:
Hand Preparator

Top: Flint, Iron, Flint.
Middle: Copper, Iron,
Copper.
Bottom: 3 Iron Ingots.

Insert feedstock and
press Crank until the
batch finishes.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Extract two fractions

Left input: 1 Sand.
Leave the other two
empty. Crank for 1
Silith.

Collect it; repeat with
1 Clay Ball for 1 Argil.

These are useful
mineral fractions, not
pure elements.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Mix and heat

Left: 1 Silith.
Middle: 1 Argil.
Right: empty.

Crank for 4 Matrix
Blend. No water
needed.

Smelt each Blend in a
furnace for 1 Matrix
Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Craft parts

Frame: Structural
Bars in the corners,
Iron Ingots along the
edges and Matrix
Blend in the center.

Circuit: Copper Ingots
in the corners,
Redstone above and
below Matrix Blend,
and Argil to its left
and right.
guide.rematter.page.6:
Bars and Racks

Structural Bars: Iron
Ingots across the top
and bottom rows, Silith
left and right in the
middle. Makes 12.

Cell Rack: Bars down
both sides, Control
Circuits top and
bottom center, Silith in
the middle. Makes 2.
guide.rematter.page.7:
64k Matter Cell

Housing: Structural
Bars in the corners
and Glass along the
edges.

Stack top to bottom:
Control Circuit
Matrix Crystal
Cell Housing

Its reusable Crystal
is not fuel.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Colored crystals

Craft a Matrix Crystal
with one dust:
Gold: Amber
Copper: Copper
Diamond: Mint
Emerald: Leaf
Lapis Lazuli: Blue
Amethyst: Violet

Silith makes Ice and
Redstone makes
Ember.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Starter machines

With Frames, Circuits
and Bars:
Preparator: 2 Amber.
Decomposer: 2 Copper.
Synthesizer: 3 Leaf,
Glass.
Drive: 1 Mint, 2 Racks.

The recipe book
shows each grid.
guide.rematter.page.10:
First network

Drive: Machine Frames
in the corners, Cell
Racks to either side
of a Control Circuit,
Structural Bars
above and a Mint
Matrix Crystal below.
guide.rematter.page.11:
First network


Place Decomposer and
Synthesizer beside
the Drive. Insert a
Cell in any bay and
supply FE to both
processors.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Sand into storage

Open Decomposer.
Insert Sand in its
input and press Start.

Its cutter separates
stored Silica into the
connected Drive.

The Cell stays in
storage. Processors
do not accept new
Cells.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Side tabs

Process: inputs and
progress.
Contents: storage.
Upgrades: speed or
efficiency.
Configuration:
automation and
settings.

Hover symbols and
bars for help.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Make glass

Open Recipe, search
Glass and select it.
Use recipe, then Start.

Collect the Glass from
the Synthesizer.

Default: 1 Sand to 1
Glass, 24,000 FE total.
The Cell remains in the
connected Drive.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Control work

Start: one recipe
batch. Pause and
Resume keep the
order.

Configuration: enable
Automation and Run
nonstop.

Use hoppers to feed
Decomposer and empty
Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Why a crystal?

Heating bonds the
mineral blend into a
porous crystal matrix.
Selective storage in
that matrix is fiction,
inspired by real
material separation.

A Cell holds stock.
Recipes describe
products; they add no
matter.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Powered preparation

Material Preparator
uses FE. Inputs run
left to right; unused
slots stay empty.

Grind Iron, Copper or
Gold Ingots into Dust,
1:1, for 4,000 FE each.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Five useful fractions

Sand gives Silith.
Clay Ball gives Argil.

Powered preparation
also gives:
Redstone: Rhedon.
Quartz: Virel.
Glowstone: Lumin.

Each extraction costs
2,000 FE. Silith + Argil
makes Matrix Blend.
guide.rematter.page.19:
Alloy powders

Powered inputs, left to
right:
Rhevon: 3 Iron Dust, 1
Copper Dust, 1
Rhedon.
Lumivex: 3 Copper
Dust, 1 Gold Dust, 1
Lumin.

Each batch makes 4
Powder for 8,000 FE.
Heat next.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Virelite Ceramic

Mix with FE: 1 Silith + 1
Argil + 1 Virel = 4
Virelite Powder.

Sinter Furnace: 1
Powder to 1 Ceramic
for 12,000 FE.

Rhevon and Lumivex
Powder sinter into
Ingots at the same
cost.
guide.rematter.page.21:
Heat and recycle

Alloy Powder smelts
or blasts to Ingots,
1:1.

Preparator, Mekanism
Crusher and Oritech
Pulverizer grind
Ingots back to the
same Powder.

Oritech Foundry: 2
Powders to 2 Ingots.
guide.rematter.page.22:
Advanced powders

Powered, left input
only:
Diamond: Powder.
Emerald, Lapis,
Amethyst: Dust.
Ender Pearl: Powder.
Netherite Ingot:
Powder.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.23:
Component blends

Left, middle, right:
Diamond Powder, 2
Matrix Blend, Gold
Dust.

Ender Pearl Powder, 2
Lumivex Powder,
Copper Dust.

Netherite Powder, 2
Rhevon Powder,
Virelite Powder.
guide.rematter.page.24:
Sinter components

Sinter Furnace, 1
Blend:
Diamond Lattice: 12,000
FE.
Ender Conductor:
16,000 FE.
Netherite Sheath:
24,000 FE.

Lattices: circuits,
upgrades. Conductors:
Cells, Ports.
guide.rematter.page.25:
Larger Cells

Each Cell stores up to
512 types. Capacities
are 64k, 256k and 1M
units.

256k uses a Matrix
Cluster and two Ender
guide.rematter.page.26:
Larger Cells

Conductors. 1M uses
four Clusters, an
Optical Circuit, Diamond
Lattice, an Ender
Conductor and a
Netherite Sheath.
guide.rematter.page.27:
Industrial Preparator

Shell: 3–9 wide and
deep, 5–9 high. Use at
least a 3×4 or 4×3
footprint and 2 Ports.

Cutter + Filter +
Basin. Each mounts on
guide.rematter.page.28:
Industrial Preparator

floor or ceiling. Click
a support's top or
bottom face.

More Cutters/Basins:
speed. More Filters:
less FE.
guide.rematter.page.29:
Analyzer and limits

Insert a sample and
supply FE. The
Analyzer shows
composition and keeps
the item. No Cell
needed.
guide.rematter.page.30:
Analyzer and limits

Analysis is not an
unlock. Synthesis
permits approved
materials, not
machines or
components.
guide.rematter.page.31:
Water later

Connect Electrolyzer
and Reactor to a
Drive with a Cell.
Supply FE.

Import a water bucket
through Decomposer;
keep its input empty.

Choose Water
electrolysis, Use
recipe, then Start.
guide.rematter.page.32:
AE2 and RS

Use one Network
Interface per system.
In Configuration,
choose its backend
and turn Automation
on.

Enable Network jobs
on processors. Both
systems can request
supported recipes
from shared stock.
guide.rematter.page.33:
Industrial Reactor

Shell: 3-9 wide/deep,
4-9 high; 2+ Ports.

Stabilizer + Focus.
Both mount on floor
or ceiling and turn
automatically.

More Foci: speed. More
Stabilizers: less FE.
Connect outward
Ports.
guide.rematter.page.34:
Expand the network

Each Drive holds six
removable Cells. Start
with one.

Up to 64 Drives.
Nodes: 256, 384 or
512 by lowest cable
guide.rematter.page.35:
Expand the network

tier.

Upgrades: four of one
type. Speed +25% FE
each. Efficiency -5%
FE each.
guide.rematter.page.36:
When work waits

Check matter, inputs,
FE and output room.
Cables link the
network and forward
pushed FE.

After a Cell or
guide.rematter.page.37:
When work waits

network change, the
batch restarts by
itself.

Keep unreadable Cells
safe.
guide.rematter.page.38:
Before you start

Early midgame:
external FE, iron,
copper, redstone,
gold, sand, clay and
glass.

The starter Drive
guide.rematter.page.39:
Before you start

needs 1 diamond; the
Synthesizer needs 3
emeralds. Glass
teaches controls.
Build next for silicon,
bronze or steel.
guide.rematter.page.40:
Useful silicon

With a supported
silicon mod, ReForging
uses quartz: 1 quartz
-> 1,000 crystalline
silica -> 1,000 silicon
+ 1,000 oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.41:
Useful silicon

Synthesizer: 250
silicon per item. Four
items cost 160,000
base FE in total. Keep
or explicitly vent new
oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.42:
Specialist machines

Separator: soil to
carbon, silica and
water; carbon helps
make steel.

Thermal Processor:
phase changes.
guide.rematter.page.43:
Specialist machines

Crystallizer: approved
crystals. Every
diamond form needs a
Pressure Module.

Export stored liquids
through Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.44:
Air and byproducts

Air Separator: 200
oxygen, 16,000 base
FE, 200 ticks.
Overworld, air above
and open sky.

Mekanism tubes can
export oxygen from
guide.rematter.page.45:
Air and byproducts

an automated Drive.

Production settings
can vent selected NEW
gases, after
confirmation. Stored
gas stays safe.
guide.rematter.page.46:
Targets and parallel
work

Production settings: 0
disables the target.
Processes count
network
substance/phase;
physical outputs
count the local
buffer. Full batches
guide.rematter.page.47:
Targets and parallel
work

cannot exceed the
target.

3 Parallel Upgrades
give 4 industrial lanes.
Each pays full FE. All
savings together cap
at 25%.
guide.rematter.page.48:
Ownership and repairs

Cables and machines
belong to their placer.
Foreign cables do not
connect. FTB Teams
members can operate
devices without
merging stock.
guide.rematter.page.49:
Ownership and repairs


Invalid chamber: use
Locate missing part.
Close the menu to
follow the outline, then
repair the diagnosed
block.
